prose: Meta's new personal AI agent, Muse, was tried by more than 500,000 people roughly a week after launch, including more than 250,000 daily active users, The Information reports, citing internal data. Users submitted more than 2 million prompts in its first week.
highlights: Muse surpassed 500,000 total users about a week after launch, per internal data.
More than 2M prompts were submitted in the first week.
